sections.title: The Virtuous Woman
observations: This section describes the characteristics of a virtuous woman, emphasizing her strength, wisdom, and industriousness. She is portrayed as a capable manager of her household, demonstrating both diligence and resourcefulness. The passage highlights the importance of character and moral integrity in a woman, which is a reflection of her relationship with God.

sections.title: The Praise of the Husband
observations: The husband of the virtuous woman praises her, recognizing her value far above rubies. This acknowledgment underscores the importance of mutual respect and admiration in a marriage. It also reflects the biblical view that a godly woman is a treasure to her family.

sections.title: The Fear of the Lord
observations: The chapter concludes with the reminder that charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised. This highlights the ultimate standard of worth in a person, which is their reverence for God. It encourages readers to prioritize spiritual qualities over superficial attributes.

importantVerses.commentary: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.
Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.

questions: What qualities define a virtuous woman according to this passage?
How can the principles found in this chapter be applied in modern relationships?
In what ways does the fear of the Lord influence a person's character and actions?
